beats.narration_text: Hallo — this is Liam, in for Komal, for Madison's weekly update. Team Madison locked the visibility pilot's plumbing this week. Thirty-nine prompts, shuffled into one hundred seventeen attempts. Five local tests passed. Zero live queries. Plus three other tracks moving: laptop responses, Loon Conservatory access, and archetype-detector research.

beats.narration_text: Team Madison shipped one receipt with numbers, and three tracks that are not that receipt. The visibility pilot can run. It has not run. That distinction is the week.

beats.narration_text: First receipt: the runner. Thirty-nine unique prompts, shuffled into a run plan of one hundred seventeen attempts — each prompt three times, so a one-off answer cannot hide as a result. The runner pulls every prompt on its own. No copy-paste. Full structured response every time. Alongside: the model, the settings, a timestamp, the attempt number, the raw response, and its status.

props.sparkLine: A run plan, not a result.
props.caption: Three repeats. So a one-off cannot hide.

beats.narration_text: Before any real data: counting rules. A mention is not a recommendation. Order is not a ranking. Every count ships with its denominator. Then five local validation tests. All passed. Thirty-nine prompts valid. One hundred seventeen requests correctly prepared. None of those requests have been sent. Zero live queries. Zero collected answers. Zero visibility metrics. Next: confirm the model and the access, check recording end to end, then compare across profiles — small, before the full collection.

beats.narration_text: Separately, the laptop recommendation study is testing prompts and starting to collect real model responses. That is not the visibility pilot. Loon Conservatory: A.P.I. access for the metadata annotation tool, a demo model ahead of the meeting, and work on the brand document and the presentation. And research has started on a Jungian brand-archetype detector. Started — not built.
